summary: Creates a DAT output connector on a Component so internal DAT data can be published through the component boundary.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Popup label shown when hovering the Component output

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Use input or node script language for DAT editing behavior

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Choose the edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom extension used when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Out DAT is a component-boundary connector, not a file writer or table generator.
Component outputs are positioned alphanumerically on the right side of the parent Component.
Use a matching In DAT and Out DAT convention when generating reusable components with DAT ports.
The label affects UI affordance only; downstream wiring still depends on connector order and node names.
key_concepts: Creates a DAT output connector on a component boundary.
The Label parameter controls the connector label shown on the parent component.
Out DAT provides a stable exported table or text output from inside reusable components.
Common DAT parameters still control language, editor extension, custom extension, and word wrap.
